doc: Architectures this build refuses on purpose, each by the FEATURES it would need and does not have (Level C). A refusal is data like everything else: when the feature exists, delete its entry and write the adapter.

refuse.why: AltUp/Laurel residual wiring and activation sparsity are not modelled yet
blocksparse attention and muP scalings (remote code) are not modelled
ChatGLM remote code is not modelled
CodeGen's mp_num-partitioned qkv layout is not modelled
MiniCPM3 (MLA + muP remote code) is not modelled yet
Zamba2 shared-attention hybrid is not modelled yet

RWKV-5/6 exist only as remote code (modeling_rwkv5/6.py), not in transformers; their group-norm eps, rescale and LoRA widths cannot be checked offline — the WKV-5/6 recurrence is in the TIR library, the config is not lowered yet

RWKV-7 is implemented by flash-linear-attention, not transformers; its config keys and tensor names cannot be checked offline — the WKV-7 recurrence is in the TIR library, the config is not lowered yet
